ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(NOT(BEGINS(RelativeEndpoint__c, "/")), BEGINS(RelativeEndpoint__c, "//"), CONTAINS(RelativeEndpoint__c, "://"), CONTAINS(RelativeEndpoint__c, "\\"), CONTAINS(RelativeEndpoint__c, "?"), CONTAINS(RelativeEndpoint__c, "#"), CONTAINS(RelativeEndpoint__c, ".."))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter a relative path beginning with /. Schemes, hosts, backslashes, query strings, fragments, and parent traversal are not allowed.
